about: Linear mean albedo of the near ground library textures (8 px mip of each draft_* KTX2, sRGB-decoded), measured 2026-11-03 from generation 2e6515f4 tiles. The far ground pigment must equal the near material's distant colour. `near` is keyed by the material key without its draft_ prefix; the longest contained key wins. `legacy` translates the pigments of scenery derivatives built before this table (old fixed palette, unmatched keys white); remove it once the scenery cache has been rebuilt with tools/remote-drafts/scenery.mjs from this commit. `survey` holds the survey/L2 ground classes: `land` and `street` are the area-weighted means of the authored far ground (this table's `near` pigments) over t0_0_0, t0_1_0, t0_-1_1, t0_2_-1 and t0_1_1 (land = every class but asphalt and water); `built` is the regional built-up class, the combined land+street mean.
